trips.route_note: Regular intercity buses run from Dubai's Al Ghubaiba and Ibn Battuta stations to Abu Dhabi's central bus terminal, from where local buses or taxis reach the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and Corniche.
trips.tour_query: Abu Dhabi day trip from Dubai
trips.why: Regular intercity buses drop you at the central terminal with local connections to the Grand Mosque and Corniche.
know: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque has free entry but modest dress is required
Avoid Friday mornings when the mosque is busiest with worshippers
Book mosque visits ahead during peak season
